faq: What kind of pets can I bring to Paws & Cogs?
Paws & Cogs accepts all types of pets, including dogs, cats, birds, and small animals.
How much does the dog walker service cost?
The cost of the dog walker service varies depending on the length of the walk and the number of dogs.
Do you offer any repair services for my pet's toys or equipment?
Yes, we offer a range of repair services for your pet's toys and equipment, including cleaning, fixing, and customizing.
